chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Hanan ibn Sadir, from his father, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام; and from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl, from Abu al-Sabbah, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbade the meat of the sacrificial offerings after three days, then he permitted it. He said: Eat from the meat of the sacrificial offerings after three days and store it.

key_terms.لُحُومِ الْأَضَاحِيِّ: the meat of the sacrificial offerings

ai.seo_question: Was it permissible to keep and eat the meat of sacrificial animals after three days?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم initially prohibited keeping the meat of sacrificial animals beyond three days, then later permitted it. The narration indicates a change in ruling regarding storing and eating sacrificial meat after three days.
